category.name: Image generation and editing
category.description: Text-to-image, image editing, inpainting, upscaling and background removal.

entries.name: Adobe Firefly Services API
entries.auth_hint: OAuth2 Server-to-Server (Client ID/Secret via Adobe IMS); Authorization: Bearer <token>, token valid 24h
entries.free_tier: check pricing; requires Adobe Developer Console project and Firefly Services entitlement
entries.desc_en: Generate and edit images and manage creative assets programmatically via Adobe's Firefly REST APIs.
entries.notes: Enterprise-leaning; needs OAuth Server-to-Server credentials from Adobe Developer Console, not a simple sign-up API key.

entries.name: Black Forest Labs FLUX API
entries.free_tier: paid only, no free tier (FLUX Schnell weights are open for self-hosting)
entries.desc_en: Generate, edit, and vary FLUX model images from text prompts via REST or the official OAuth MCP server.
entries.notes: Official MCP server (flux-mcp) is remote/hosted at mcp.bfl.ai with OAuth-only login, billed to your BFL org.

entries.name: Freepik API
entries.auth_hint: x-freepik-api-key header (migrating to x-magnific-api-key under Magnific rebrand)
entries.free_tier: free tier: ~5 EUR of free API credits, then pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Generate and edit images programmatically via REST API, plus access Freepik's stock asset library.
entries.notes: Freepik rebranded to Magnific in April 2026; docs/domains and auth header are mid-migration from freepik.com to magnific.com.

entries.name: Google Gemini / Imagen image API
entries.free_tier: check pricing (free API key tier exists but image models are mostly usage-billed)
entries.desc_en: Generate and multi-turn edit images from text via REST (Nano Banana/Imagen models), up to 4K with reference-image support.
entries.notes: Also available via Vertex AI for enterprise/cloud_iam auth as an alternative.

entries.name: Ideogram API
entries.free_tier: no free API credits (web app has 10 slow credits/week); API is pay-per-image, $40 min top-up
entries.desc_en: Generate, edit, remix, upscale, and describe images via REST or an official OAuth MCP server, strong at in-image text.
entries.notes: API billing is separate from Ideogram web subscriptions; requires payment method for API access.

entries.name: Leonardo.Ai API
entries.free_tier: $5 free API credits after account verification, then pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Generate images and videos from text via REST or the official MCP server, with model selection and job status polling.
entries.notes: Requires a verified account with a payment method to receive API credits.

entries.name: OpenAI Images API (gpt-image)
entries.free_tier: paid only; no free image credits, usage-based billing
entries.desc_en: Generate, edit, and iteratively refine images from text prompts via REST, with mask-based inpainting and streaming previews.
entries.notes: Requires an OpenAI API account with billing enabled; part of the Images API / Responses API.

entries.name: Recraft API
entries.free_tier: paid only; pay-per-image (from $0.007/image on V4.1 Flash), no confirmed free credits
entries.desc_en: Generate, edit, upscale, and vectorize images via REST API using Recraft's proprietary models.
entries.notes: REST API, OpenAI-Python-library compatible for some endpoints (not all params supported); official MCP server on GitHub.

entries.name: remove.bg API
entries.free_tier: free: 50 API calls/month (preview/small resolution only), then paid credits
entries.desc_en: Remove image backgrounds programmatically via a simple REST API with JSON or multipart uploads.
entries.notes: IMPORTANT: remove.bg API is being discontinued - stops accepting requests on December 1, 2026, with removal moving to Leonardo.ai.

entries.name: Stability AI Platform API
entries.free_tier: 25 free credits on signup, then pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Generate, upscale, and edit images via REST (Stable Image Ultra/Core/SD3 models) using simple credit-based billing.
